tasks.title: Resolve verifier budgets and trusted-address continuity
tasks.dod: Record Accepted ADR-0006/0007 starting values and synchronize model/spec/API policy with explicit remaining T2 and deployment obligations; benchmark evidence belongs to post-scaffold T21, not this gate.

tasks.title: Resolve publication, clock and reservation state machines
tasks.dod: Record Accepted ADR-0008/0009 PostgreSQL-write/time and simplified quota policy, synchronize sources/API/tasks, and put exact concurrent quota reservations in backlog T22 outside the v1 DAG; runtime proof remains implementation work.

tasks.title: Bootstrap the backend with executable quality gates
tasks.dod: Docker backend smoke test, pnpm test/lint/typecheck/build scripts and a deliberately invalid layer-import fixture prove active gates; no sensitive endpoint serves before readiness.

tasks.title: Bootstrap the neutral frontend and register shared primitives
tasks.dod: Neutral-shell/component tests prove no disclosure request on navigation, keyboard focus/labels/busy states at 360px, active layer lint and green Docker frontend test/lint/typecheck/build.

tasks.title: Promote the staged lifecycle migration and Lucid model
tasks.dod: Disposable PostgreSQL integration tests apply/revert/reapply the promoted Lucid migration and test all 1–1440-minute durations, invalid digests/times, uniqueness and no sensitive columns.

tasks.title: Implement exact validation, token handling and bounded verification
tasks.dod: AC-citing unit tests cover multibyte/exact multiline boundaries, surrogate rejection, canonical token padding bits, exact code comparison, malformed verifiers and reviewed work-queue exhaustion.

tasks.title: Implement bounded Redis payload and admission transitions
tasks.dod: Real-Redis integration tests prove basic rolling counters and retained histories, hard storage/cardinality/work caps, original expiry and safe OOM/timeout publication; acknowledge concurrent quota overshoot without requiring deferred reservation leases.

tasks.title: Implement bounded cleanup and generation-fenced readiness
tasks.dod: Real-Redis/PostgreSQL tests measure <=60s active deletion during normal healthy operation; outage/dependency-down/suspension delay is accepted. Recovery must catch all expired backlog (including debt older than the last tick/recent interval) before serving, preserve safe PostgreSQL time/current-run guards, deny expired release and never reconstruct payloads; no scheduler redesign for startup PostgreSQL downtime or deferred quota-lease protocol is required.

tasks.title: Implement confirmed creation and its HTTP boundary
tasks.dod: createSecret contract/integration tests assert safe outcomes, fixed PostgreSQL-INSERT creation/expiration timestamps, shortened usable lifetime, no link on uncertain writes, basic observed 25-success checks and orphan nonextension.

tasks.title: Implement neutral status and durable lifecycle classification
tasks.dod: getSecretStatus contract tests verify four 200 variants, malformed token stops before lookup, no fragments or mutation, known expiration after Redis restart and 503 for corruption/dependency uncertainty.

tasks.title: Implement explicit disclosure with final release checks
tasks.dod: discloseSecret tests cover safe HTTP outcomes, basic observed five-failure checks with acknowledged concurrent overshoot, hard global work admission, repeat readers and final PostgreSQL-time/readiness checks after asynchronous verification.

tasks.title: Implement typed browser clients and conservative lifecycle guards
tasks.dod: Deterministic client/clock tests cover wall-clock rollback, transit, suspend discontinuity, invalid/superseded late responses and stale clipboard callbacks with zero late display eligibility.

tasks.title: Build the exact creation form and lifetime/code controls
tasks.dod: SCR-01 component tests cover every manifest state, 1/60/61/1440/fractional minute interactions, multibyte size boundary, code point/generator behavior, retained input and single-submit/no-auto-retry.

tasks.title: Build guarded share confirmation and separate handover
tasks.dod: SCR-02 tests prove only confirmed link/code handover, separate exact copy, safe failure feedback, no credential repetition, accessible countdown and local expiry disabling all handover actions.

tasks.title: Build neutral reading gate and explicit Show interactions
tasks.dod: SCR-03 tests cover all manifest states, no POST on navigation/resume/status, explicit repeated Show, missing/wrong/short codes, shared-pair 429, safe 503/offline return and 409 reclassification.

tasks.title: Build exact reading and distinct unavailable screens
tasks.dod: SCR-04/05 tests assert byte-exact multiline field/clipboard text, denied-copy manual fallback, no script/link execution, all safe terminal states and no late/stale/partial content restoration. Reading-route integration tests prove status → explicit Show → SCR-04/05 and concealed return at the original URL.

tasks.title: Wire same-origin deployment and confidentiality controls
tasks.dod: Disposable Compose smoke/integration checks prove direct same-origin routing, private stores, no-store/no-referrer on all outcomes, startup fail-closed and inspected Redis persistence/noeviction configuration.

tasks.title: Verify canary confidentiality and fault-recovery boundaries
tasks.dod: Canary audit has zero payload/code/full-link log/backup hits; fault suites prove no late releases, <=60s deletion during normal healthy operation and all-expired-backlog cleanup before serving after accepted outage/dependency-down/suspension delay, or explicitly block launch on remaining unmet obligations with evidence.

tasks.title: Verify all screens, exact copies and browser lifecycle safety
tasks.dod: AC-citing E2E/accessibility tests pass on the approved narrow/desktop browser matrix with zero app console errors, no automatic disclosure and no stale/late plaintext after lifecycle transitions.

tasks.title: Measure workload budgets and install aggregate synthetic checks
tasks.dod: Reproducible load report records achieved eligible throughput/p95, error/limit mix and deletion latency; synthetic/alert smoke tests pass without sensitive labels, and monthly availability remains explicitly unmeasured until a full calendar window.

tasks.title: Benchmark Reading code budgets after backend scaffolding
tasks.dod: Reproducible Docker hash/verify benchmark records pinned versions, host/container limits, cold/warm latency, RSS, event-loop delay, throughput and refusals for ADR-0006; retain starting values or record a reviewed adjustment before T20.
